notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes show a June 2, 2026 call for Three Forks Rodeo and list the Community Center 406-272-3716 with an instruction to call the chamber. Adventure Zone Gmail shows a strong prior relationship. The official rodeo site already lists July 16-17, 2027 for the 2027 rodeo; no arbitrary outreach due date was created. Source: handwritten call notes, page 85; Adventure Zone Gmail/current official rodeo website.
